scope: Diagnosis of installed-libdxfrw dangling LAYER plot-style reference in generated LibreCAD DXF version test
fixture: The existing LibreCAD dxf_roundtrip_tests.cpp version test writes a locally authored ASCII DXF from its embedded literal and changes its ACADVER. The selected output files are scratch-only.
source_trace: For an ordinary unbound LAYER with no supplied source plot style, dxfRW::writeLayer emits group 390 = F. writeObjects generates the root and group dictionaries but does not automatically emit the F placeholder for this profile. isDxfFixedOutputHandle does not reserve F.
comparison: The bundled codec passes the broader [filter][version] selector (8 cases, 118 assertions). The installed codec has 4 failing cases / 9 failed assertions with both the current guard and the unchanged pre-guard filter. The six failures in the generated version test all have precisely the 390 F dangling reference. Two separate export-refusal failures remain undiagnosed.

next: Design an output graph for default plot styles with a real correctly typed, uniquely owned target; plan handles before TABLES, account for source/caller-supplied ACAD_PLOTSTYLENAME dictionaries and collision at E/F, and verify independent ASCII/Binary graph readback, rollback, repeated saves and consumer compatibility. limits: Generated controls and a reader observation do not establish native plotting behavior, source graph closure, broad support or any phase/external-gate completion. The six scratch DXF outputs are not committed.
